# Brainform demo stand

A demo of Brainform's AI shopping assistant, presented as three independent storefronts on one site: electronics,
sport and outdoor, and beauty. Each storefront has its own catalogue and its own search API, reached under its own
path prefix. Catalogue data, prices and reviews are demo data, and no order placed here is processed.

Each storefront page registers its own store's WebMCP tools in a browser that supports WebMCP, so an agent running in
the browser can search that store's catalogue and ask questions about it without clicking through the page. The tools
a page offers are the ones that store's own MCP endpoint lists; the documents linked below describe each store's
server, its interfaces and its limits.

## Electronics store
- [Storefront](https://demo.brainform.ai/demo/brownmarket)
- [MCP server](https://demo.brainform.ai/krups-api/.well-known/mcp.json)
- [Agent card](https://demo.brainform.ai/krups-api/.well-known/agent-card.json)
- [Agent manifest](https://demo.brainform.ai/krups-api/.well-known/ard.json)

## Sport and outdoor store
- [Storefront](https://demo.brainform.ai/demo/bluemarket)
- [MCP server](https://demo.brainform.ai/bluemarket-api/.well-known/mcp.json)
- [Agent card](https://demo.brainform.ai/bluemarket-api/.well-known/agent-card.json)
- [Agent manifest](https://demo.brainform.ai/bluemarket-api/.well-known/ard.json)
